contra: Composição: 51% poliéster / 49% algodão — confirma o texto do P05; o texto do P04 (52% algodão / 48% poliéster) vale para Rib Wide, Plissé, Ripple e Waffle, não para a Piqué. São duas composições na mesma "linha texturizada".

Preço: a tabela diz "sob consulta" em todas as faixas, mas o resumo diz "a partir de R$ 41,30" e a página mostra "a partir de R$ 53,10" — equivale à base R$ 59,00 das outras texturas (inferido; confirmar).

"Tingimento reativo": corante reativo só tinge a parte de algodão; poliéster exige corante disperso (tingimento em dois banhos). Pedir o processo real — risco de cor desigual ou mescla não intencional.
"Interlock com relevo" / "tecelagem": piquê é malha de ponto carregado; não é interlock nem tecido plano.
"Ribana... sem canelado": ribana é, por definição, canelada; nas fotos a gola é uma faixa lisa com pesponto.
Prazo: aqui "despacho em até 3 dias úteis"; nas outras texturas, 24 h úteis.
Comparativo diz "Chinese Cotton 180g"; a ficha P06 é 160 g.
A página da Rib Wide descreve a Piqué como "micro-mesh (furinhos)" e cita uma Ottoman Texture 240g não catalogada.
Cor "Azul Celeste" nas fotos é um azul-médio vivo, não celeste.

prompt.garment: a regular fit t-shirt in 240gsm piqué knit (51% polyester / 49% cotton), {COR}, the whole surface covered in a fine, uniform micro-mesh of tiny raised diamond-shaped cells about 1 mm across in a regular grid, exactly like a classic polo-shirt piqué, with tiny recessed pores between the cells, fully matte with a dry, crisp hand, set-in shoulders, short sleeves ending mid-bicep with a turned double-stitched hem, medium-width smooth clean crew-neck band (no ribbing) with a visible single topstitch line, straight double-stitched hem at the hip, fully opaque
prompt.bottom: light-wash blue jeans with ripped distressing
prompt.colors: AZC (vivid medium cornflower blue — fotos #1–3), BCO (bright white — #4–5), VSG (muted sage green — #6–8)
prompt.behavior: Fabric and construction: medium-weight 240gsm piqué with a firm, slightly springy structure — the polyester-rich blend keeps the body smooth and wrinkle-resistant; it falls straight and clean from the shoulders without clinging and shows almost no creases. The micro-diamond grid gives the surface a fine, even pebble texture that under soft light reads as a subtle honeycomb grain across the chest; on white the tiny pores show as a delicate pale-gray dot pattern, on colors as a slightly two-tone, heathered depth. Matte, dry-looking surface, no sheen. Smooth collar band with topstitch; reinforced shoulder-to-shoulder seam; chain-stitch seams; turned double-stitched hems at sleeves and bottom. Movement: crisp and resilient — folds are few, soft and rounded, and the fabric springs back after being pinched, the texture staying fully defined inside the folds.
prompt.fit: Fit on the model (size M on a 1.84 m, 84 kg man): body length 72 cm ending at the hip, chest width 54 cm giving 2–4 cm of relaxed ease, shoulder width 46 cm with the shoulder seam sitting exactly on the shoulder point, sleeve length 18 cm ending mid-bicep. Little stretch: crisp, clean regular silhouette.
